seo.title: Thank You | Maxima Pools
seo.description: Your estimate request is in. Here is what happens next, when we will call, and the numbers we call from.
seo.ogDescription: Your estimate request is in. Here is what happens next and the numbers we call from.

hero.subtitle: We have received your details and are excited to help build your backyard paradise.

numbers.title: Save our consultation numbers
numbers.intro: So you know it's us calling or texting — an unknown number is easy to miss.
numbers.proactiveNote: Want to get ahead of it? Call us at (614) 384-5081 during business hours.

next.title: What happens next?
next.body: To give you the most accurate pricing and clear up any questions, our process always begins with a quick phone call. Calling you directly is the absolute fastest and most efficient way to get your project on our scheduling calendar.

items.title: During business hours
items.body: Our normal operating hours are Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM. A member of our team will review your submission and call you at the earliest opportunity within those hours. We occasionally try after 5:00 PM, but we are unlikely to answer calls that late.

items.title: Nights & weekends
items.body: If you are sending this over the weekend or outside our regular hours, rest assured we will call or text you first thing on the next business day.

tools.title: While you wait, take a dive into these tools
tools.subtitle: Everything here helps us have a shorter, sharper call when we reach you.

items.title: Pool models
items.body: Over 100 shapes and sizes to explore, with dimensions, depths and photos of each one.

items.title: Virtual pool simulator
items.body: Don't just imagine your pool — see it. Experiment with shapes, features and sizes to picture exactly how your oasis fits your yard.

items.title: Explore the pool info section
items.body: Dive into construction materials, cutting-edge accessories and design trends to find the low-maintenance fit for your lifestyle.

items.title: Easy financing plans
items.body: A pool is a major investment, but it shouldn't be stressful. Review our financing options and find a monthly payment that fits your budget.

closing.title: Thank you. Talk to you soon!
closing.body: Keep an eye on your inbox — we just sent you a copy of these numbers and next steps.
